svg.title: Deployment and SDK supply chain
svg.desc: A reviewed Git commit is packaged into a ZIP with a source manifest and uploaded to a private versioned Amazon S3 bucket. The repository host is independent of the CodeBuild S3 source. CloudFormation pins the commit, manifest hash and S3 object version. CodeBuild verifies the package, builds the Docker image and pushes it to ECR. The reviewed release selects that image digest in CloudFormation, which updates ECS Fargate. An optional Lambda can trigger and await the build when ContainerImage is blank; it is not required by the digest-pinned release flow. A separate create-only Lambda seeds DynamoDB.
svg.text: Build, deploy and SDK supply chain
CodeBuild builds the reviewed source; CloudFormation deploys the selected ECR digest
Commit SHA + source version + manifest SHA-256 pinned in stack parameters
ContainerImage blank → Lambda starts and polls CodeBuild
Returns build ID / status; the task uses the configured image tag
With a pinned ContainerImage, the trigger skips the build
S3 version, manifest, complete file set, hashes and modes are checked.
BUILD_REVISION + OCI revision label identify the verified Git commit.
Execution/task roles supply secrets and scoped service permissions.
Two demo records on stack Create only
Separate from voice traffic and post-call workers.
Source: scripts/package_source.py · infra/template.yaml · infra/buildspec.yml · Dockerfile · pyproject.toml
